newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Telesp, Embratel may be sold off in '97.
newsitem.headline: Telesp, Embratel may be sold off in '97.

text.p: Sao Paulo telecom firm Telesp and long-distance unit Embratel, subsidiaries of federal Telebras system, may be auctioned off at the end of this year, said Telebras president Fernando Xavier Ferreira.

"The Communications Ministry's intention is to privatize Embratel and Telesp in the first place, maybe at the end of this year," Ferreira told reporters after speaking at a seminar on private savings.
The federal government plans to privatize the entire telecommunications sector by the end of 1998.
